mostWorthwhile.text: Making the membrane bag was most worthwhile: the cutaway showed how the fats form a boundary with water on both sides.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two transport proteins was straightforward and a little repetitive, although their pictures showed different routes.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the membrane bag’s picture description also mentioned structures we had not fitted yet, such as mitochondria and a pump. That made it less clear which parts were actually present.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the goals and pictures gave each pairing a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would try another chapter to see how more cell parts fit together, though this chapter’s choices were mostly predictable.
